text:
Sam K.: Hey all — just started with Billing this week. I can’t find the Grafana billing-overview dashboard or the SLO panels for invoices.success. Also need Sentry release-health for billing-prod. Email: sam.k@redwood.ai. Who handles these access bits?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome! :wave: Usually Okta auto-provisions groups. Quick checklist: Okta -> add to observability-viewers for read access. For Sentry we add you to the billing project. If the group isn’t visible open an identity request and paste the ID here.
Sam K.: I see observability-viewers but no billing-specific groups. Okta shows my groups: [observability-viewers].
Nina (Platform): For EU-prod (redwood-eu-prod) billing resources are in a separate namespace. I can add Sentry once you include a short justification on the identity request (reason: oncall + triage). We’ll also need your device approval for eu-strict.
infra-bot: Automated: Datadog invite queued for sam.k@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1800-INV-22. Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1819994322
Sam K.: Filed identity request REQ-203404 — justification: ramping on billing incidents + dashboard access for debugging.
Jules (DevEx): Tagging @Maya — can you grant Grafana view to Sam and share the billing folder? Note: billing dashboards live under /team/billing. If Sam needs to annotate deploys enable the deploy-events datasource for the folder.
Maya (Eng): Done: added Sam to folder viewers for /team/billing. Dashboard slug: billing-overview. If you want edit perms update the identity request to grafana:editor. To verify via API you can run:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" https://grafana.internal/api/search?folderIds=21 | jq '.'
```
Sam K.: Datadog invite arrived, thanks. Where do the billing SLOs live? I only see infra and platform SLOs.
Nina (Platform): Datadog SLOs are on the composite dashboard service-slos — filter by tag service:billing or by namespace billing:prod. For Sentry release-health make sure your GitHub username is linked in the invite flow so Sentry can attribute releases.
security-bot: Policy note: EU-prod access requires company-managed device + disk encryption. Confirm your device is approved at https://idp.redwood/devices and MFA is enabled.
Sam K.: Accepted Sentry invite and can view release health now, nice. One ask: I’m running a short loadtest later and want to add an annotation in Grafana for the test window. Can I get edit perms temporarily?
Jules (DevEx): Short answer: we usually don’t give blanket edit perms. Options: 1) update the identity request to grafana:editor and state the time window, or 2) ask an owner to post the annotation during the test.
Maya (Eng): I’ll post the annotation for your 3pm CET run if you DM me the exact start/stop and a brief note.
Sam K.: Perfect — scheduling 3pm CET, will DM the exact window. Thanks everyone :rocket:
